messages.subject: Corpus Project
messages.body_plain:
Dear members,

For an international project, we are looking for teams to collect
Persian and Arabic written and spoken corpora.  The project is a very
comprehensive one.  The estimated budget for the corpora of these two
languages is $ 500,000.  Please contact me for further information.

--
Dr. Cem Can
Cukurova University
Faculty of Education
01330 Balcali
Adana - TURKEY

e-mail: cem...@cu.edu.tr
phone: +90 532 628 34 08
skype: cemcan
IM: cem...@hotmail.com
